verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a first-party Zero Data Retention feature that lets users delete all data associated with completed tasks (smooth-docs-10), so it does offer its own retention and deletion control. That control is gated to enterprise plans, and the evidence is a single thin doc mention. Community concerns about sending data to a third party are general skepticism, not concrete contradiction. missing for 10: availability outside the enterprise tier, configurable retention periods, documented per-task or per-profile deletion endpoints, details on what data is retained and for how long, independent or hands-on corroboration.
